observations: Photo 0: a white front-loading washing machine standing on a bare concrete floor.
Photo 0: 'LG' logo top left and 'INVERTER DirectDrive 7kg' printed on the control panel; a small model code under it is too small to read with certainty (looks like F10..QDP..).

Photo 0: programme dial (Cotton, Cotton Quick, Synthetic, Delicate, Baby Care, Rinse+Spin, Quick 30, Blanket, Hand Wash/Wool), option buttons and a digital display panel; the display is off, so it is not shown powered.
Photo 0: 'DD MOTOR 10 year warranty' sticker and an LG 'Less Noise, Less Vibration, More Durability' sticker on the front.
Photo 0: rust along the top edge of the front panel and along the bottom kick plate; scuffs and dirt on the body.
Photo 0: door glass and white door ring look intact; no view of the drum inside, door seal, back, hoses or power cord.

read_from: photo 0 control panel: 'LG' logo and 'INVERTER DirectDrive 7kg' label

claims.evidence: Photo 0 control panel reads 'LG' and 'INVERTER DirectDrive 7kg'.
A photo cannot show the location.

claims.claim: For sale as a working washing machine (implied)
claims.evidence: The display is off in photo 0 and there is no clip of a wash or spin cycle.

risks.risk: Machine does not power on, fill, drain or spin
risks.proof: A clip of the machine powered on, filling with water, the drum turning and a spin, with the display lit

risks.risk: Worn drum bearings or a faulty direct drive motor, loud on spin
risks.proof: A clip of the spin cycle with the sound audible, and a clip of the empty drum turned by hand
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing bearing or motor repair

risks.risk: Rust spreading to the cabinet base or inside, beyond what photo 0 shows
risks.proof: Photos of both sides, the back and the base of the cabinet

risks.risk: Torn or mouldy door seal, or damaged drum
risks.proof: A close-up photo through the open door of the drum and the folded door seal
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing a door seal

risks.risk: Missing inlet hose, drain hose or power cord
risks.proof: Photo of the back showing hoses and power cord

risks.risk: Exact model differs within the range
risks.proof: Close-up of the rating sticker on the back or inside the door
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lowest LG 7kg DirectDrive model

proof_requests: Clip of the machine powered on, filling, washing and spinning, with the display lit and sound on
Close-up of the rating sticker on the back or inside the door
Photo through the open door of the drum and door seal
Photos of both sides, the back and the base
Photo with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we give
response.reason: Photo 0 reads LG Inverter DirectDrive 7kg on a front loader, so it can be priced at its worst case, as not working with a rusted cabinet, until a running clip and the rating sticker are shown.
